plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one focused S&C session each week around your higher sparring load. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift so later percentage work is grounded in a real baseline, and the main training starts in Week 2. The emphasis in this block is simple, beginner-friendly force and power work with low equipment demands, keeping quality high without adding too much fatigue on top of boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic lower-body strength and simple explosive ability with recoverable volume that fits around sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the same main lifts steadily while trimming unnecessary volume and keeping power output crisp.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it faster with more ballistic and boxing-friendly power work.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps and jump as high and fast as you can. Land softly and stop if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if space is tight. Start from a still quarter squat and jump straight up.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low safe box and step down each rep. Keep takeoffs fast and landings quiet.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up in small jumps, then work up to one hard clean set of 3-5 reps. This sets your baseline for future percentage work, so stop with solid form and no grinding.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your baseline for later work.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if one dumbbell is too light. Keep elbows up and depth consistent.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Same setup and intent if you have a kettlebell instead of a dumbbell.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Lower with control, keep the back flat, and feel the hamstrings load. Leave 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Drive the elbow back, pause briefly at the top, and keep the torso still. Leave 1-2 reps in reserve.
